evidence.summary: LSP/MCP-compatible remote clients share the same resident generation and event cursor.

summary: The resident service now reuses whole-document snapshots and dependency fingerprints, publishes exact generation-bound semantic deltas, and rejects late frontend results. Whole-document frontend invalidation remains: changed documents are still re-analyzed from scratch.
